name: D-2B8
description: D-2B8 was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. A counterpart of AG-11 who was fond of him, D-2B8 was stationed aboard the frigate Toron Voq when the ship was attacked by the Sith warship Red Reaper in the Rhinnal system and was destroyed along with the droid.
